item.title: Version 2.7.0
item.description:
What's New in 2.7.0

✨ New Features

  • Choose the language Remio speaks — Settings ▸ Language lets you set Remio to English, Vietnamese, French, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Hindi or Brazilian Portuguese on its own, without changing the language of everything else on your Mac. Leave it on Follow system and nothing changes.

⚙️ Improvements

  • Your own devices connect without pairing again — Signing in to the same Remio account on a phone, tablet or another computer is now enough for this Mac to recognise it. No six-digit PIN, no QR code — even when the device signs in and connects seconds later.

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an external display not returning to its own resolution — After a session on a Mac running with the lid closed, the external monitor could be left at the wrong resolution — everything on it bigger or softer than before — and stayed that way until you set it back by hand.
  • Fixed the "Check your inbox" screen vanishing mid sign-up — Creating an account with an email address showed the verification screen for a moment and then dropped back to the sign-in buttons, so clicking the link in the email never completed the sign-up.
